lines.text: God says He is against Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, who will fall on the mountains of Israel.
The people of Israel's cities will burn the weapons as fuel for seven years.
God gives Gog a burial place in the Valley of Achor, and Israel buries his hordes for seven months.
God tells Ezekiel to call the birds and beasts to a great feast on the mountains of Israel.
God will restore Israel from captivity, leave none behind among the nations, and pour out His wrath on the house of Israel.
